info.name: Content + Expense + Expense Category + Area + Service + Location APIs
info.description:
Includes APIs for content management (`/api/content-management`), expense category management (`/api/expense-category-management`), expense management (`/api/expense-management`), area management (`/api/area`), service management (`/api/category` and `/api/service` — including **`/create-request`**, **`/update-request/:id`**, and standard CRUD), and location management (`/api/state` and `/api/city`).

**Catalogue request lifecycle (rows created via `…/create-request`):** **`is_request`** stays **`true`** and **`approval_status`** is **`pending`**. On accept (`PUT …/category|service/update/:id` with **`approval_status: "approve"`**) **`is_request`** becomes **`false`** and `rejection_reason` is cleared. On reject (`approval_status: "rejected"`) **`is_request`** remains **`true`** and **`rejection_reason`** is required.

**Normal catalogue create:** **`POST /api/category/create`** sets **`requested_by: null`**, **`is_request: false`**, **`approval_status: "approve"`**. **`POST`/`PUT` on `…/create-request` and `…/update-request/:id`** persist **`is_request: true`** (middleware / path).

Use **Login** first to set `{{token}}`, then run the requested module APIs. **Create Service** / **Create Category** tests save `{{serviceId}}` / `{{serviceCategoryId}}` on HTTP 200 when `record._id` is present. Use **Accept … Request** / **Reject … Request** requests for moderation; filter **Get All** with **`categoryApprovalStatus`** / **`serviceApprovalStatus`** (empty = omit filter).

request.description: `POST /api/category/create` — **`is_request: false`**, **`requested_by: null`**, **`approval_status: "approve"`**. Use **Create Category Request** for user-submitted rows (`is_request: true`, `approval_status: "pending"`, `requested_by` set).

Requires non-empty **service_ids** (run **Create Service** first or set `{{serviceId}}`). Server sets **`is_request: true`**, **`requested_by`**, **`approval_status: "pending"`**. Test script saves `{{serviceCategoryId}}` on HTTP 200. Approve/reject with **Accept Category Request** / **Reject Category Request** on `PUT /api/category/update/:id`.

Approves a pending category request: **`approval_status`** → **`approve`**, **`is_request`** becomes **`false`**, **`rejection_reason`** cleared. Use catalogue category id in URL (`{{serviceCategoryId}}`).
Rejects request: **`approval_status`** → **`rejected`** and **`rejection_reason`** required. **`is_request`** stays **`true`**. Empty reason returns **400**.
General metadata update — **`approval_status`** omitted. For moderation use **Accept Category Request** / **Reject Category Request**.

`PUT /api/category/update-request/:id` — same required fields as **Create Category Request** (multipart). Keeps **`is_request: true`**. Prefer **`Accept`/`Reject Category Request`** on `PUT …/category/update/:id` with JSON **`approval_status`** for moderation-only calls.
`POST /api/service/create` — normal service; **`is_request: false`**, **`requested_by: null`**. Priced/active per body.

`POST /api/service/create-request` — **`is_request: true`**, **`requested_by`** set, **`approval_status: "pending"`**. Price may be **0**. Test saves `{{serviceId}}`. Approve/reject with **Accept Service Request** / **Reject Service Request** on **`PUT /api/service/update/:id`**.
Approves service request: **`approval_status`** → **`approve`**, **`is_request`** becomes **`false`**, reason cleared. Service id in URL (`{{serviceId}}`).
